newsitem.title: UK: Crude pipeline to Russia's Tuapse reopens.
newsitem.headline: Crude pipeline to Russia's Tuapse reopens.

text.p: A crude pipeline feeding the Russian Black Sea port of Tuapse has reopened after being shut at the weekend for maintenance but the Ukranian port of Odessa has shut due to bad weather, shipping sources said on Wednesday.
The Tuapse pipeline, which closed late on Sunday, reopened at 0920 (local time) on Tuesday, the sources said.
One crude oil tanker berthed at Tuapse late on Tuesday but had not yet started to load.
The port of Odessa closed at midnight (local time) with south-easterly winds moderating force 10 or 12 preventing tankers from berthing.
Russia's biggest crude export terminal at Novorossiisk was operating normally as was the Baltic port of Ventspils.
